name: 79761 · Odessa, TX
findings: ZIP 79761 (Odessa) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79761 (Odessa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79761 (Odessa) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
